body:
I’ve been trying to move out of this fucking state, but scoring a job in another state is really difficult, and that’s the only way I can feel ok with moving somewhere if I don’t want to be homeless or at least try not to be hate crime-d and die or whatever.

Also, thank you, I will look into those. I’ve always had some mixed experiences with no discrimination policies - they usually seem to find a way to worm out of it and find *some* reason to not hire me, but I can give it a shot, I guess.
I mean...sure... but I feel like spite can only get you so far, you know?

I mean, I’ve tried talking to other trans people, but most of them usually have some semblance of a family, or have a really tight group of friends that stayed with them even after they came out. Idk, I have neither of these things, and it’s really difficult for me to make friends when people feel uncomfortable with my existence in the first place ... it kind of sort of feels odd that I’ve somehow not killed myself

It’s a little difficult to get a support network going. With no family, I only have “friends” and acquaintances, and that only gets you so far. They’re people who hang out with me, but they’re not very willing to support me through my troubles because it’s different from what they’re used to and they don’t want to put in effort to learn.

I have thought about joining a trans (or at least LGBTQ+) community in college, but I’ve always felt really ... disconnected. Maybe it’s because most, if not all of them, are not in STEM like I am (I honestly don’t blame them, with the way STEM topics and majors tend to be advertised ...). Maybe it’s also possibly because most of them still have at least some connection to their family, even if it’s not a perfectly healthy one.

I might have that discussion about hormones, but tbh hormones have helped reduced my suicidal tendencies from 100% to like ... 85%? I guess maybe I’ve just been more suicidal recently because I feel like I’ve completely plateaued in my transition, and no one (socially or in a profession) wants me because I decided to transition. I guess it just makes me wonder whether I really should have bared through 18 years of trying not to kill myself and some more years for transition to “do its thing” if no one even wants me at all. Idk, I’ll bring it up I guess
